description: Golden set for the fictional Northwind Freight sample documents. Answerable questions list every (document, page) that contains the answer; a retrieval hit means at least one of them is in the top results. answerMustContain are facts the generated answer has to mention (case-insensitive). Unanswerable questions must be refused.
